title: Etale structure-sheaf cohomology in smooth proper curve families
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]) [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to S$ a proper smooth morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] with nonempty geometrically connected fibres [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] of dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ and $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$ be the associated etale structure-module sheaves [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], placed in the same coefficient universe as the abelian direct-image and Artin--Schreier functors. If a universe lift is used, each section group is $\operatorname{ULift}(\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V))$ with the transported addition and scalar action; the same sectionwise lift is used for $E_{\mathrm{et}}$ below. The natural map $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}\to f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ is an isomorphism. There is a finite locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module $E$ (Zariski-locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_S^{\oplus r}$ for a finite integer $r$ allowed to vary between opens) with
$$R^1f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}\cong E_{\mathrm{et}}$$
as $\mathcal O_{S,\mathrm{et}}$-modules. These higher direct images are computed in abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], with the natural scalar action induced by multiplication by pullbacks of base functions; $E_{\mathrm{et}}$ is as in [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module].

source.place: Tag 0GKA, label lemma-genus-in-nodal-family-of-curves, (a),(b), smooth-curve specialization; etale form using Tag 03P2, etale-cohomology.tex, label theorem-zariski-fpqc-quasi-coherent; the same assertion with a sectionwise coefficient-universe lift

proof.text: Smoothness gives flatness and local finite presentation. Properness gives quasi-compactness and a closed-immersion diagonal, hence quasi-separatedness and finite presentation. Fibres are proper and geometrically reduced. Geometric connectedness and the $H^0$ criterion give the canonical bijection $\kappa(s)\to H^0(X_s,\mathcal O)$. Their dimension is one by hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0GKA, hypotheses for the perfect-complex argument

proof.text: Apply the flat-curve derived-model lemma to $f$. Thus $K=Rf_*\mathcal O_X[0]$ has $H^0(K)=\mathcal O_S$ by the structural map, $E=H^1(K)$ is finite locally free and quasi-coherent, locally $K\cong\mathcal O_S[0]\oplus E[-1]$, and every canonical $\delta_g$ is invertible. Apply the coherent affine-edge lemma with $G=\mathcal O_X$ and $A=H^0(K)$: it supplies simultaneous linear bijections $e_v:H^1(X_V,\mathcal O)\cong\Gamma(V,v^*E)$ with the required restriction equation.

source.place: Tag 0GKA, local model and compatible base change

proof.text: Use the affine-cohomology realization lemma with $q=1$, $G=\mathcal O_X$ and these $e_v$. Properness gives the required quasi-compact separated morphism. It yields $R^1f_*\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}\cong E_{\mathrm{et}}$ with the natural scalar action, simultaneous coefficient lift and normalized raw-class formula. This includes restriction compatibility and linearity on all etale objects.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 with the simultaneous coherent comparison; affine restriction and sheafification

proof.text: For degree zero, universal proper-flat global sections applies because $f$ is proper flat finitely presented with geometrically reduced connected fibres. For affine etale $V$, it makes $B=\Gamma(X_V,\mathcal O)$ free of rank one over $R=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. Write $B=Re$, $1_B=ce$, $e^2=de$. From $e=1_Be=cde$ follows $cd=1$, so the structural map $r\mapsto rce$ is bijective. The degree-zero coherent comparison identifies it with the structural etale map, using the same lift. Affine opens cover every etale object; faithful affine restriction detects that this structural map is an isomorphism.
